verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vertex AI as a first-party AI platform for building and scaling agentic systems (google-cloud-docs-15, google-cloud-docs-29). It also mentions free-tier 'AI APIs' (google-cloud-docs-31) and documented REST/client-library Cloud APIs (google-cloud-docs-4), which together imply a managed AI service with an API. None of the evidence explicitly describes managed model inference, which frontier models are served, or open-model hosting. Missing for 10: explicit managed inference/model-serving documentation, named frontier models, open-model catalog or hosting, model-specific API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.
